title: Correct Exposure in Photoshop - Day 22
summary: PHLEARN's Day 22 tutorial demonstrates a non-destructive workflow for correcting image exposure in Photoshop using Adobe Camera Raw. The instructor converts the layer to a smart object via Smart Filters, applies a global Camera Raw auto adjustment, and refines exposure with highlights, shadows, and vibrance. The lesson then masking a subject to apply local adjustments, removes a stray background figure with the Remove tool, automatically straightens the horizon, and revisits Camera Raw to fine-tune skin tones with the Color Mixer (Point Color). The approach emphasizes non-destructive editing with re-editable Camera Raw settings and provides a concise, repeatable sequence for improving exposure while preserving skin tone naturalness.

sections.title: Intro and setup: Smart Objects and Camera Raw
sections.description: Introduces the goal of correcting exposure with Camera Raw and demonstrates converting the target layer into a smart object via Filter > Convert to Smart Filters to enable non-destructive edits.

sections.title: Global exposure correction with Auto in Camera Raw
sections.description: Shows opening Camera Raw via the Filter menu, using the Auto control to balance highlights and shadows, and mentions adjusting exposure and vibrance afterward for a blanket image-wide correction.

sections.title: Subject masking setup: isolating the person
sections.description: Demonstrates selecting the subject using Camera Raw’s masking tools, including the automatic 'People' detection to isolate the person for targeted edits.

sections.title: Local adjustments on subject via mask
sections.description: Applies exposure, temperature, and color corrections specifically to the masked subject, showing how local adjustments differ from global edits.

sections.title: Background removal and horizon straightening
sections.description: Uses the Remove tool to erase an unwanted background element and applies an auto horizon/geometry correction to straighten the scene.

sections.title: Revisiting Camera Raw for skin color correction
sections.description: Reopens the Camera Raw filter on the smart object to fine-tune skin color with the Color Mixer (including Point Color targeting), adjusting hue, saturation, and luminance for a natural skin tone, with before/after comparisons.

sections.title: Wrap-up and takeaways
sections.description: Concludes with a recap of the non-destructive workflow, confirms adjustable Camera Raw settings via the smart filter, and invites viewers to continue with the series.
